# PD model monitoring report (generated by `creditcast.validate`)

**Out-of-time window:** 2017Q1-2019Q4  |  **Model:** logistic GLM discrete-time hazard (champion), XGBoost challenger

## 1. Performance (out-of-time)

| Model | AUC | Gini | KS | Brier | Mean predicted | Mean actual |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GLM | 0.786 | 0.572 | 0.446 | 0.00112 | 0.0549% | 0.1118% |
| XGBoost | 0.798 | 0.595 | 0.459 | 0.00112 | 0.0987% | 0.1118% |

Hosmer-Lemeshow style test (GLM, OOT): chi2 = 154.3, p = 0.000 (indicative only: rare events).
Quarterly default-rate MAPE (OOT): 43.3%.

## 2. Calibration by K-Means segment (OOT)

| Segment | Loan-quarters | Defaults | Predicted defaults | Binomial test p |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 30,924 | 118 | 58.4 | 0.000 |
| 1 | 31,480 | 34 | 8.1 | 0.000 |
| 2 | 164,691 | 102 | 58.1 | 0.000 |

## 3. Forward back-test

Loans alive at 2015Q4 (13,820), realised macro, 2015Q4 to 2019Q4: predicted cumulative default 0.858% (119 loans) vs actual 1.548% (214 loans).

## 5. COVID appendix

2020-2021 actual default rate 0.693% vs predicted 0.115% (AUC 0.722). 2020-2021 90+ DPD delinquency is dominated by CARES-Act forbearance, not credit deterioration: the actual default rate spikes (the model, built on credit drivers, under-predicts it) while ranking power stays reasonable. These quarters are excluded from all headline metrics.

## 6. Monitoring plan

- Quarterly: AUC/Gini/KS, predicted vs actual default rate, PSI of score and drivers (thresholds above).
- Annual: recalibration review, challenger comparison, assumptions review.
- Triggers: PSI > 0.25 on the score, or actual/predicted default ratio outside [0.5, 2] for two consecutive quarters.
